'''Hyperwind storms''' were a violent weather phenomenon caused as a result of climatic change on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], forcing the native [[Utai/Legends|Utai]] and [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'ans]] into the sinkholes on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
